history_summary.value: The Pyncheon is an old, rare American true bantam whose ancestors are thought to have come from the Netherlands or Belgium to the northeastern United States. It is notable for appearing in Nathaniel Hawthorne's novel The House of the Seven Gables, which he wrote while keeping the breed.
